details: Materials: 1 mL Ethanol, 1 mL Glacial ethanoic acid, Conc. H2SO4, Water bath, Beaker

branches.theme: Master Glossary, Definitions, Formulas, and Laws

details: Definition: A series of organic compounds having the same functional group, similar chemical properties, and differing adjacent members by a -CH2- unit (14 u mass difference).
Application / Example: Alkanes: CH4, C2H6, C3H8.
Statement / Formula: CH3COOH + C2H5OH --(Acid)--> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O
Variable Definitions / Units: Ethanoic acid + Ethanol -> Ethyl ethanoate (sweet smelling ester) + Water
Model Application: Used in synthetic flavors and perfumes.
evidence_or_examples: Used in synthetic flavors and perfumes.
key_terms: Ethanoic acid + Ethanol -> Ethyl ethanoate (sweet smelling ester) + Water
